City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 15, 2023 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the December 21, 2022, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2023-02-15 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2023-02-15 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Off-cycle Fiscal Year 2022-23 Budget Appropriation of $142,240 from Vehicle Replacement Fund and Authorization to Purchase Fleet Vehicle. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" per Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Operations Manager Gonzalez
1) Adopt Resolution Number 2023-01, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2022-23 Adopted Budget" approving an off-cycle appropriation to the Fiscal Year 2022-23 operating budget for the Fleet Vehicle Replacement Fund (Fund 535); and 2) Authorize the purchase of a new Utility truck in accordance with the attached quote, for an amount of $129,309, plus a 10 percent contingency of $12,931, for a total amount not to exceed $142,240.
2023-02-15 SDWD Item S08D Off Cycle Appropriations for SDWD Utility Vehicle
8E.
Emergency excavation and leak investigation to the 36-inch water main located within the intersection of Encinitas Boulevard and El Camino Real, Encinitas. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board of Directors, the authorization to pay for emergency repairs, is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under 15301(b), maintenance of publicly owned utilities. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Olson
District Board authorize the payment of $93,323 to Burtech Pipeline, Incorporated (Burtech) for emergency excavation and leak investigation completed on the 36-inch water main located within the intersection of Encinitas Boulevard and El Camino Real, Encinitas.
2023-02-15 SDWD Item S08E SDWD Emergency Excavation Encinitas and El Camino
8F.
Quitclaim of Water Easements to 534 Ocean View, LLC Located at 534 Ocean View Avenue, Encinitas (APN 256-151-19-00). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" per Section 15378(b)(5) of the CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Consent Item. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Olson
1) Adopt Resolution No 2023-03, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Approving Quitclaim of Water Easement on 534 Ocean View Avenue, Encinitas (APN 256-151-19-00);" and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Public Water Easement.
2023-02-15 SDWD Item S08F Quitclaim 534 Ocean View Ave
8G.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2021-22 Basic Financial Statements Report and Year-End Budget Report. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manger II Kazungu
1) Receive and file the San Dieguito Water District Basic Financial Statements for the year ended June 30, 2022; and 2) Receive and file this report reflecting the San Dieguito Water District's actual FY 2021-22 available ending net position of $14,398,375.
2023-02-15 SDWD Item S08G FY21-22 Year-End Budget Report
8H.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2022-23 First Quarter Budget Report. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manger II Kazungu
Adopt Resolution No. 2023-02, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2022-23 Budget," to reflect the revised actual beginning net position of $14,398,375.
2023-02-15 SDWD Item S08H FY2022-23 1st Quarter Budget
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.

1) Receive a report from Scott McClelland, General Manager, Encina Wastewater Authority (EWA) on "One Water North San Diego;" and 2) Consider signing on as an advocacy Agency for EWA Potable Reuse Project.

INFORMATIONAL ITEMS

2023-02-15 SDWD Item S11A Lake Hodges Informational Report

BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF

13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 15, 2023
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
